name: isentropic_nozzle_critical
title: Isentropic nozzle with critical pressure (choked / unchoked flow)
summary: Steady isentropic nozzle on air, sized from a given mass flow: total-enthalpy conservation, isentropic throat state, throat pressure max(back pressure, critical pressure) so the model switches between unchoked and choked regimes; real-gas gamma solved from the isentropic relation.

authors: TBD (ULiège MSTh course team: J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio)
origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition 1, TP 01

verification.summary: EES stored values (5/16 vars; M_dot, P_su, T_su exact; h_su/s_su only the documented Air reference offsets) and the self-consistent last-solution set kept in the EES guess column agree: max rel diff 4.3e-03 on T_thr (EES 7.458 vs CoolProp air), all physics variables within rtol 0.001. Choked run: throat velocity within 0.02 % of the local speed of sound.
verification.reference: EES stored values and last-solution guesses of Isentropic Noozle.EES (comparison via tools/compare_solution.py); analytical speed of sound at the choked throat
verification.notes: vs stored values: '4 common variables, 2 differ (rtol=0.001)' (Air reference offsets on h_su, s_su). vs last-solution guesses: '16 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001)' (3 Air offsets, stale DELTAP guess of 1 in EES, T_thr 4.3e-03). Choked run: no EES reference, sonic-throat check 0.02 %.
